notes: Minifigure parts (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded.
Exact stud positions were hard to read from the small drawings, so ports are left null and some attachments are inferred (e.g. which pieces the 1x4 plate and the Technic brick sit on).
The hinge sub-assembly in step 4 is labelled 393726 twice; I treated the top piece as the hinge top plate (lego-3938) and the base as lego-3937.
The 2x6 plate is placed under the rear of the wedge brick in step 2. In step 3 the two inverted slopes are attached to it.
The minifigure placed in the cockpit is not in the parts list, so it is not recorded.
The windscreen is assumed to sit on the 2x2 plate and both 1x2 plates (b4, b5, b6).
The attachment points of the two equipment pieces (b24, b25) are not clear from the drawing. I assumed both attach to the black 2x6 plate (b7).
The axle runs through the Technic brick (b12). The 9-diameter propeller (b22) goes on the axle and the 5.5 propeller (b23) goes on the pin.
The tile with top pin (b18) is assumed to sit on the hinge top plate (b14).
Only one trans-yellow round plate is in the parts list. I attached it to the camera piece (b25).
Page 2 also has a copyright notice and advertising for other sets, which add nothing.
